baseline.title: Advice on Integrating LLM-Generated Game Character Content into a Mobile App
baseline.body: I'm an iOS developer looking to add a feature in my app that generates game-related character information such as backstory, age, and stats. I'm considering whether to use API-based LLMs like OpenAI, Claude, or Gemini, or to run a local LLM directly on the phone. I want to understand the trade-offs between these options, including setup complexity, user login management, costs, app size, and performance impacts. Additionally, I'm curious about what preparation is needed to deploy a local model, including whether fine-tuning is necessary. Finally, I want to know if there are ways to limit the model's output to avoid sexual or controversial content. Any guidance on model selection, deployment strategies, and content filtering would be appreciated.
